fusions.name: Seed Bomb
fusions.desc: Throws a seed pod that deals 30 damage and bursts for 80% of it on every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Pruning Snip
fusions.desc: A quick cut that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tended Bed
fusions.desc: Turns the soil where you stand for 10 seconds. It restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Green Thumb
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
